summary: The gyomu-workflow package provides the core workflow orchestration engine for the Gyomu CLI. It manages snapshot execution, request validation, target resolution, and incremental processing through checkpoints, while executing specialized pipeline actions like docstring updates, LLM context generation, and package structuring.
responsibilities: Manage snapshot workflow execution, targets, checkpoints, and action configurations.
Validate and repair Python package structures and snapshot requests.
Execute specific workflow actions such as directory generation, docstring updates, LLM context generation, package processing, and README generation.

capabilities.name: Workflow Pipeline and Checkpoints
capabilities.description: Orchestrates workflow execution steps, manages checkpoints for incremental processing, and tracks pipeline states.

capabilities.name: Request Validation and Target Resolution
capabilities.description: Resolves target files, validates snapshot requests, and verifies Python package structures.

capabilities.name: Specialized Pipeline Actions
capabilities.description: Executes specialized pipeline tasks including directory generation, docstring updates, LLM context generation, and README creation.

design_decisions: Implements checkpointing and fingerprinting to support incremental workflow execution and track completed steps.
Uses distinct models for snapshot requests, targets, options, and actions to maintain separation of concerns.
Integrates specialized modular packages for python analysis, docstring processing, and concept generation.
usage_guidance: Use the snapshot execution runner to initiate workspace or project-level snapshot workflows based on validated configuration requests.
Leverage checkpoint utilities to track pipeline progress and avoid redundant execution of completed workflow steps.
